games_not_covered.description: The number of games the team did not cover the spread.

games_not_covered_pct.description: The percentage of games a team did not cover the spread.

games_over_total.description: Team Games where the total score was over the pre-game Over/Under point total

games_pushed.description: The number of games that resulted in a push on the spread.

games_started_pct.description: Percentage of games a player played that were also started.

games_under_total.description: Team Games where the total score was under the pre-game Over/Under point total

hook_shot_rate.description: Percentage of FGA that were hook shots

inactive_games.description: The number of games on the roster but inactive. Must be INACTIVE on game roster, AVAILABLE STARTING IN 2017-18.

jumper_fga.description: Field goal attempts that were jumpshots

jumper_rate.description: Percentage of FGA that were jumpshots

layup_rate.description: Percentage of FGA that were layups

minutes_per_game.description: The number of minutes played per game.

net_efg_pct.description: Team effective field goal percentage minus opponent effective field goal percentage

net_fg_pct.description: Team field goal percentage minus opponent field goal percentage

net_ft_pct.description: Team free throw percentage minus opponent free throw percentage

net_three_made_per_game.description: Team 3PT Made Per Game - Opponent 3PT Made Per Game

net_three_pct.description: Team three-point percentage minus opponent three-point percentage

net_true_shooting_pct.description: Team true shooting percentage minus opposing true shooting percentage

net_two_point_pct.description: Team 2-point percentage minus opponent two-point percentage

net_win_pct_home_vs_away.description: The difference between a team's winning percentage in home games vs. away games, negative indicates better away

off_foul_pct.description: Percentage of personal fouls that were offensive.

off_foul_pct_of_to.description: Percentage of turnovers that were from offensive fouls.

off_reb_diff.description: Team offensive rebounds minus opposing offensive rebounds.

off_reb_diff_game.description: Team offensive rebounds minus opponent offensive rebounds per game.

off_reb_pct.description: An estimate of the percentage of available offensive rebounds grabbed by a team (Team-level only)

off_rebounds_per_game.description: The number of offensive rebounds per game.

opp_blocks.description: Blocks from the opposing team, or Team Blocks Against.

opp_def_reb.description: Defensive rebounds by the opposing team, or defensive rebounds allowed

opp_def_reb_pct.description: An estimate of the percentage of available defensive rebounds grabbed by the opponent (Team-level only)

opp_def_reb_per_game.description: Defensive rebounds recorded by opponent per game

opp_efg_pct.description: Opponent field goal percentage adjusting for 3-pointers being worth more than 2-pointers

opp_fg_pct.description: Field goal percentage allowed by a team

opp_fga.description: Shot attempts by the opposing team, or field goals attempted allowed.

opp_fga_per_game.description: The number of Opponent field goal attempts per game.

opp_fgm.description: Made shots by the opponent, or field goals made allowed.

opp_fgm_per_game.description: The number of Opponent field goals made per game.

opp_ft_pct.description: Accuracy on free throw attempts by the opposing team. Free throw percentage allowed.

opp_fta.description: Free throw attempts from the opposing team, or free throws allowed

opp_fta_per_game.description: Opponent free throw attempts per game

opp_fta_rate.description: Free throw attempts per field goal attempt of the opposing team, or free throw rate allowed.

opp_ftm.description: Made free throws from the opposing team, or made free throws allowed

opp_ftm_game.description: Opponent free throws made per game

opp_off_reb_pct.description: An estimate of the percentage of available offensive rebounds grabbed by the opponent (Team-level only)

opp_off_rebs.description: Offensive Rebounds by the opponent, or offensive rebound allowed

opp_pf.description: Personal fouls by the opposing team, or personal fouls drawn.

opp_player_to.description: The number of player turnovers by the opponent (not team turnovers).

opp_player_to_per_game.description: The number of opponent player turnovers per game.

opp_points.description: Total number of points scored for the opponent

opp_points_off_to_per_game.description: The number of opponent points off turnovers per game

opp_points_off_turnover.description: The number of points scored by an opponent off turnovers.

opp_rebs.description: Offensive and defensive rebounds for the opposing teams, or total rebounds allowed.

opp_shooting_poss.description: An estimate of the number of shooting possessions for the opposing team -- FGA+(0.44*FTA)

opp_shooting_poss_per_game.description: An estimate of the number of the average number shooting possessions (FGA+(0.44*FTA)) for the opposing team per game

opp_steals.description: Steals by the opposing team, or steals allowed.

opp_team_tos.description: The number of team turnovers by an opponent

opp_three_att.description: Three point attempts by the opposing team, or three point attempts allowed.

opp_three_att_per_game.description: The number of Opponent 3 point attempts per game.

opp_three_att_rate.description: Opponent's number of 3-point attempts per field goal attempt, or three-point rate allowed.

opp_three_made.description: Threes made by the opposing team, or made three pointers allowed.

opp_three_made_per_game.description: The number of Opponent 3 point field goals per game.

opp_three_pct.description: 3pt percentage from the opposing team, or 3pt percentage allowed

opp_to_pct.description: An estimate of opponent turnovers per 100 plays.

opp_tot_to_game.description: The total number of turnovers (player and team) per game

opp_total_to.description: The total number of opponent turnovers (player and team)

opp_true_shooting_pct.description: An opponent shooting percentage that accounts for the value of both 3-pointers and free throws

opp_two_att.description: 2-point attempts from the opposing team, or 2PA allowed.

opp_two_att_rate.description: Opponent's number of 2-point attempts per field goal attempt, or two-point rate allowed.

opp_two_made.description: 2-pointers made by the opposing team, or 2PM allowed.

ot_point_diff.description: Team points minus opponent points, overtimes only.

over_pct.description: Percentage of Team Games where the total score was over the pre-game Over/Under point total

pace.description: An estimate of possessions per 48 minutes

paint_attempts.description: The number of field goal attempts in the paint.

paint_attempts_per_game.description: FGA in the paint per game.

paint_fga_plus_three_att.description: Field goal attempts in the paint or three point attempts

paint_fgm_per_game.description: FGM in the paint per game.

pct_assists_from_dunks.description: Percentage of assists that came from dunks.

pct_assists_from_dunks_layups.description: Percentage of assists from dunks and layups.

pct_assists_from_layups.description: Percentage of assists that were from made layups.

pct_fga_layups_dunks_threes.description: Percentage of FGA that were layups, dunks, or 3s.

pct_fga_paint.description: Percent of field goal attempts that are taken from the paint

pct_fgm_assisted.description: Percentage of made shots that included an assist. Teams only.

pct_fgm_dunks.description: Percent of Field Goals Made That Are Dunks

pct_fgm_outside_paint.description: Percentage of made field goals that were outside the paint.

pct_games_double_double.description: Percent of games where player records a double-double

pct_of_fgm_assisted.description: Percentage of opposing made shots that included an assist.

pct_of_rebs_off.description: Percentage of a player or team's total rebounds that were offensive rebounds.

pct_of_team_gp.description: The percent of team games in which a player plays

pct_of_tos_live.description: Percentage of team turnovers committed that were stolen by the opponent.

pct_opp_turnovers_live.description: The percentage of turnovers forced (or opponent turnovers committed) that were stolen by the team. (Non dead-ball.)

pct_paint_fga_plus_three_att.description: Percentage of total field goal attempts from in the paint or three-point attempts.

pct_points_ft.description: Percent of total points scored by free throw

pct_points_paint.description: Percent of total points scored in paint

pct_points_second_chance.description: Percent of total points that were second chance

pct_points_via_bench.description: Percentage of total team points scored by bench players.

pct_points_via_fast_break.description: Percentage of total points scored via fast break

pct_points_via_starters.description: Percentage of total team points scored by starters.

pct_rebs_def.description: Percentage of a player or team's total rebounds that were defensive rebounds.

personal_fouls_per_game.description: The number of personal fouls per game.

pf_diff.description: Opposing personal fouls subtracted by team personal fouls (a Negative number indicates a Team has MORE fouls than their opponent).

pf_diff_per_game.description: Team personal fouls committed versus drawn per game (a Negative number indicates a Team averages MORE fouls per game than their opponent).

pl_win_pct.description: Percentage of games won (when player played)

player_bench_points.description: The number of points scored by players that did not start.

player_bench_points_per_game.description: Points per game by a player when they did not start.

player_own_shots_blocked_per_game.description: The number of shot attempts blocked per game.

player_pct_of_offense.description: Percentage of team points created by a player. Points plus Assisted Points.

player_pct_team_assists.description: Percentage of Assists accounted by an individual player (MUST include Team Split.  NOTE: When looking at season, it's all assists for a team WHEN THE PLAYER WAS ON THE ROSTER, not just games a player played in.)

player_pct_team_fgm.description: Percentage of Field Goals Made accounted by an individual player (MUST include Team Split. NOTE: When looking at season, it's all FGM for a team WHEN THE PLAYER WAS ON THE ROSTER, not just games a player played in.)

player_pct_team_fta.description: Percentage of Free Throws Attempted accounted by an individual player (MUST include Team Split. NOTE: When looking at season, it's all FTA for a team WHEN THE PLAYER WAS ON THE ROSTER, not just games a player played in.)

player_pct_team_ftm.description: Percentage of Free Throws Made accounted by an individual player (MUST include Team Split. NOTE: When looking at season, it's all FTM for a team WHEN THE PLAYER WAS ON THE ROSTER, not just games a player played in.)

player_pct_team_points.description: Percentage of team's total points a player is responsible for. NOTE: When looking at season, it's all points for a team WHEN THE PLAYER WAS ON THE ROSTER, not just games a player played in.

player_pct_team_rebs.description: The percentage of a team's total rebounds grabbed by a player (MUST include Team Split.  NOTE: When looking at season, it's all rebounds for a team WHEN THE PLAYER WAS ON THE ROSTER, not just games a player played in.)

player_pct_team_threes_made.description: Percentage of 3-point Field Goals Made accounted by an individual player (MUST include Team Split. NOTE: When looking at season, it's all 3PM for a team WHEN THE PLAYER WAS ON THE ROSTER, not just games a player played in.)

player_played_losses.description: Player played in game and result of the game was a loss for his team

player_team_wins_in_gp.description: Player played in game and result of the game was a win for his team

player_tech_fouls.description: The number of technical fouls by player. This is the number that can qualify a player for an ejection in game, or a suspension during a season.

player_to_pct.description: An estimate of turnovers per 100 plays (for individual players)

player_turnover_diff_per_game.description: Player turnovers minus opponent player turnovers per game

player_turnovers.description: The number of turnovers made by players (not team turnovers).

player_turnovers_per_game.description: The number of turnovers made by players per game.

point_diff.description: Team points subtracted by opponent's points

point_diff_home.description: Point differential for games played at home

point_diff_per_road_game.description: Point differential for games played on the road

point_diff_qone.description: Team points minus opponent points, in first quarters only

point_off_to_diff_per_game.description: Points off turnovers minus opponent's point off turnovers per game

points_assists_rebs_per_game.description: Points plus assists plus rebounds per game played

points_in_paint.description: The number of points in the paint

points_in_paint_per_game.description: The number of points in the paint per game.

points_off_to_per_game.description: The number of points off turnovers per game.

points_off_turnover_diff.description: Points off turnovers minus opponent's point off turnovers

points_per_game_away.description: Points per game played for away games

points_per_game_diff_result.description: Points per game in wins compared to losses (negative number indicates a larger PPG in losses).

points_per_game_home.description: Points per game played for home games

points_per_game_losses.description: Points per game in games lost

points_per_game_wins.description: Points per game in games won

points_per_qfour.description: Average number of points scored in the 4th quarter

points_per_qone.description: Average number of points scored in the 1st quarter

points_per_qthree.description: Average number of points scored in the 3rd quarter

points_per_qtwo.description: Average number of points scored in the 2nd quarter

points_responsible_for.description: Sum of points a player scored and the points he contributed through assists

points_responsible_for_per_game.description: Points a player scored and the points he contributed through assists per game

points_via_assists.description: Points scored from a player's assists (ex: LeBron's credited 3 points for assisting on a 3-pointer)

points_via_assists_per_game.description: Points scored from a player's assists per game

points_via_fga.description: Total points minus free throws made

points_via_threes_assists.description: Points a player generated from assists on 3-point shots

ppg_diff_post_asb.description: Differential in Points per Game after the All-Star break (versus Before)

ppg_home_away_diff.description: Points per Game in Home games minus Points per Game in Away games (negative value means a higher PPG on the road)

pts_off_to.description: The number of points off turnovers.

rebound_margin.description: Team total rebounds minus opponent total rebounds.

rebounds.description: The total number of offensive and defensive rebounds.

rebs_per_game.description: The total number of rebounds per game.

rookie_points_per_game.description: Points from rookies per game played

second_chance_points.description: The number of second chance points.

second_chance_points_per_game.description: The number of second chance points per game.

second_quarter_point_diff.description: Team points minus opponent points, in second quarters only.

seconds.description: The number of seconds played by a player.

shooting_poss.description: An estimate of the number of shooting possessions for a player or team -- FGA+(0.44*FTA)

shooting_poss_diff.description: Team shooting possessions (FGA+0.44*FTA) minus Opposing shooting possessions. A measure of which teams manufacture extra possessions through turnovers and rebounding.

shooting_poss_diff_per_game.description: Net shot possessions (FGA+0.44*FTA) per game, teams compared to opponents. A measure of manufactured extra possessions through turnovers and rebounding.

shots_blocked.description: The number of blocked shot attempts.

steal_diff_per_game.description: Team steals minus opponent steals per game.

steals_per_game.description: The number of steals per game.

team_bench_points.description: Total points scored by players who did not start (Team level)

team_def_rating.description: Estimated points allowed per 100 possessions (TEAM stat only)

team_fouls_drawn_per_game.description: Fouls drawn against the opponent per game.

team_games.description: The total number of team games.

team_losses.description: The total number of team losses.

team_net_rating.description: Estimated points scored minus points allowed per 100 possessions (TEAM stat only)

team_off_rating.description: Estimated points scored per 100 possessions (TEAM stat only)

team_starter_points.description: Total points scored by players who were in the starting lineup.

team_to_per_game.description: The number of team only turnovers per game.

team_turnover_pct.description: An estimate of turnovers per 100 plays

team_turnovers.description: The number of team turnovers (not player turnovers).

team_wins.description: The total number of team wins.

tech_ft_pct.description: Percentage of free throws via technical fouls that are made

ten_plus_pts_wins.description: Wins by a margin of 10+ points

third_quarter_point_diff.description: Team points minus opponent points, in third quarters only.

three_att_away.description: Three Point Field Goal Attempts in away games

three_att_diff.description: Team three point attempts minus opposing three point attempts.

three_att_diff_game.description: The margin of three point attempts to opposing three point attempts per game.

three_att_home.description: Three Point Field Goal Attempts in home games

three_att_per_game.description: The number of 3 point attempts per game.

three_att_plus_fta_per_game.description: Three-point attempts and free throw attempts per game

three_att_rate.description: Number of 3-point attempts per field goal attempt

three_made_away.description: 3 Point Field Goals Made in away games

three_made_diff.description: Team made three-point shots minus opposing made threes.

three_made_diff_game.description: The margin of three point makes to opposing three point makes per game.

three_made_home.description: 3 Point Field Goals Made in home games

three_misses.description: Number of missed three point shots

three_pct_home_away_diff.description: Team three-point percentage in Home games minus team three-point percentage in Away games (negative value means a higher percentage on the road)

three_pm_per_game.description: The number of 3 pointers made per game.

to_diff_per_game.description: Turnovers forced minus turnovers committed per game.

tos_live.description: Turnovers that were stolen by the opponent.

tot_reb_diff_per_game.description: Team total rebounds minus opponent total rebounds per game.

tot_to.description: The total number of turnovers (player and team).

total_reb_pct_team.description: Percentage of available rebounds grabbed by the team (Team level only)

triple_doubles.description: Triple Doubles. Three occurrences of double digit steals, points, rebounds, assists or blocks in a game.

true_shooting_pct.description: A shooting percentage that accounts for the value of both 3-pointers and free throws.

turnovers_per_game.description: The total number of turnovers (team and player) per game.

two_att_per_game.description: The number of 2-point attempts per game

two_att_rate.description: Number of 2-point attempts per field goal attempt

two_misses.description: Number of missed two point shots

two_pm_per_game.description: The number of 2pt field goals made per game.

under_pct.description: Percentage of Team Games where the total score was under the pre-game Over/Under point total

underdog_losses.description: Games lost where the team was the underdog based on the pre-game moneyline odds

underdog_win_pct.description: Team Win Percentage in games where the team was the underdog based on the pre-game moneyline odds

underdog_wins.description: Games won where the team was the underdog based on the pre-game moneyline odds

usage.description: Percentage of team plays used by a player while he was on the floor

win_loss_diff.description: Difference between wins and losses (W - L); Games Above/Below .500
